verify-311.summary: Repo guard passed (mvox-app.git). Read #311 body (zero comments) and cross-checked every cited claim against main HEAD via git show, never touching the pipeline's working tree. Most of Gama's read holds up structurally (the #288 precedent, the gate, the catch-block comment, the spec that flips), but the four specific +page.svelte line numbers cited for the panelWorks/libraryWorks sync-reset/async-refill sites are wrong at current main HEAD — real sites are elsewhere. Full detail in findings.

findings.claim: RepertoireElement.svelte: manageAddControls gate is exactly `canManageRepertoire && context === 'repertoire'`, wrapping the Add Work select + permanently-disabled-until-selected Add button.
findings.evidence: File is src/lib/components/agenda/RepertoireElement.svelte (not the bare path the body implies). Gate: line 541 `{#if canManageRepertoire && context === 'repertoire'}`. Select: lines 543-555 (data-testid="work-manage-add-work-select", iterates `pickableWorksList`). Button: lines 556-565 (data-testid="work-manage-add-work-button", `disabled={pendingKeys.has(addWorkKey) || !selectedWorkId}` at line 560).
findings.implication: Body's read of the gate and controls is exact.

findings.claim: pickableEditionsVisible is the #288 precedent to mirror: prop declaration, default `pickableEditions.length > 0`, and a prop doc explaining confirmed-empty vs not-back-yet, held stickily by the page-level caller.
findings.evidence: Prop decl: line 204 `pickableEditionsVisible?: boolean;`. Full doc, lines 189-204, quoted verbatim: "#288 — whether \"Add to programme\" (the select built from `pickableEditions`) should render. Defaults to `pickableEditions.length > 0`, the original pre-#288 rule, for any caller that hands this component an already-resolved list (every component-level spec does, synchronously, with no page async in play). A page-level caller juggling an async, resettable picker SOURCE overrides this explicitly and STICKILY: `libraryWorks`/`libraryEditions` (which `pickableEditions` is derived from) get blanked synchronously on every reload and refilled async, so `pickableEditions.length === 0` alone cannot tell \"confirmed empty\" apart from \"not back yet\" — the override lets the caller key visibility off \"no options once loading has COMPLETED\" instead, computed and held by the caller (survives this component remounting on an agenda-skeleton flip, which loses any state kept in here)." Default computation: lines 258-262, `$derived(pickableEditionsVisibleProp ?? pickableEditions.length > 0)`. The sticky page-level compute is src/routes/+page.svelte's `$effect` at lines 1946-1953: `if (libraryPickersLoading || worksRowsLoading) return; ...; pickableEditionsVisibleByEventId = next;` — gated on BOTH `libraryPickersLoading` and `worksRowsLoading` settling.
findings.implication: Faithful, ready-to-mirror precedent. Structural difference worth carrying into the mirror: pickableEditionsVisible is per-event (Record<string, boolean>, since pickableEditions differs per event's already-programmed set) and needs BOTH `libraryPickersLoading` and `worksRowsLoading` to settle. `pickableWorksList` (next finding) is a single season-wide list built only from `libraryWorks`+`seasonRepertoire`, both settled by the same fetch as `libraryPickersLoading` alone — so `pickableWorksVisible` should be a single scalar keyed off `!libraryPickersLoading` alone, simpler than its sibling, not a Record.

findings.claim: +page.svelte: panelWorks/libraryWorks synchronous empty-array reset sites at lines 1083 and 2803, async refill sites at 1279 and 2848.
findings.evidence: None of these four lines are reset/refill sites at main HEAD. Line 1083 is `rsvpQueue.request(...)` inside `handleRsvpChange` (RSVP wiring, unrelated). Line 1279 is the opening of a doc comment for the works-load function. Line 2803 is mid-comment about `seasonManagePanelEl` focus handling (#261 note). Line 2848 is a doc-comment line for `seasonManageConductorOptions` (#209 roster-order note). The REAL sites: `libraryWorks = []` (sync reset) is line 1129 inside `resetManagement()`; `libraryWorks = works` (async refill) is line 1374, catch-reset `libraryWorks = []` is line 1382, both inside `loadManagePickers()`. `panelWorks = []` (sync reset) is line 2936; `panelWorks = works` (async refill) is line 2981, catch-reset `panelWorks = []` is line 2988, both inside `loadPanelRepertoire()`.
findings.implication: The four line citations in the issue body are stale/wrong against current main HEAD. The MECHANISM the body describes (sync blank-on-reload, async refill, catch-sets-empty) is real and confirmed at the corrected line numbers above; only the specific line numbers need correcting. Flagging as a body-accuracy issue since 'the body cites exact lines from Gama's own read' was the explicit verification contract here.

findings.claim: The catch that sets libraryWorks/libraryEditions/seasonRepertoire empty carries a comment stating 'Empty pickers, not a broken page: the row controls still work.'
findings.evidence: src/routes/+page.svelte lines 1379-1386, inside `loadManagePickers()`'s `.catch()`: `// Empty pickers, not a broken page: the row controls still work.` (line 1381) immediately precedes `libraryWorks = []; libraryEditions = []; seasonRepertoire = []; libraryPickersLoading = false;`. Exact quote match.
findings.implication: Confirms the third cause (load failure → deliberately visible-but-empty, not an error banner) and its rationale. Note this comment/strategy belongs ONLY to the libraryWorks/loadManagePickers path — the sibling panelWorks/loadPanelRepertoire() catch (lines 2985-2991) takes a DIFFERENT strategy: it also sets `panelRepertoireError = true`, which renders a visible error banner (data-testid="season-manage-repertoire-error") rather than staying silently empty. The two async sources feeding RepertoireElement's two production 'repertoire'-context callers do NOT share one failure philosophy.

findings.claim: pickableWorksList is derived at the page level and passed to RepertoireElement; a page-level pickableWorksVisible would key off the same loading-completed signal pickableEditionsVisible uses.
findings.evidence: `const pickableWorksList = $derived(pickableWorks(libraryWorks, seasonRepertoire));` at +page.svelte line 1955, fed into `WorksManage.pickableWorksList` (line 1979) inside the `worksManage` derived object (lines 1973-1990). It reaches RepertoireElement not directly from +page.svelte but through AgendaList.svelte's `worksElement` snippet (lines 336-352): `pickableWorksList={worksManage?.pickableWorksList ?? NO_OPTIONS}` at line 346, alongside `pickableEditionsVisible={worksManage?.pickableEditionsVisibleByEventId[item.id]}` at line 348 — AgendaList is the conduit, +page.svelte is where the sticky state actually lives. pickableWorksList's only two inputs, libraryWorks and seasonRepertoire, are BOTH set in the same Promise.all in loadManagePickers() (lines 1367-1386), gated by the single flag libraryPickersLoading (true at 1366, false at 1377/1385) — unlike pickableEditionsVisible, which also needs worksRowsLoading (a second, per-event source) to settle. WorksManage (src/lib/repertoire/types.ts lines 88-108) has no pickableWorksVisible field yet — confirms the slice hasn't started.
findings.implication: Natural mirror: add `pickableWorksVisible?: boolean` to WorksManage, compute it in +page.svelte via a small $effect gated on `!libraryPickersLoading` alone (simpler than pickableEditionsVisible's two-flag gate), forward through WorksManage → AgendaList's worksElement snippet → RepertoireElement's pickableWorksVisible prop.

findings.claim: Every OTHER caller of RepertoireElement: which pass resolved lists (component-level default path) and which is the page-level sticky caller.
findings.evidence: Full caller inventory (grep of main): (a) src/lib/components/agenda/AgendaList.svelte lines 340-351 — the per-event conduit described above; not itself the sticky-state holder. (b) src/routes/+page.svelte lines 7333-7345 — the season-manage panel's own direct <RepertoireElement> call, context="repertoire", `pickableWorksList={panelPickableWorksList}` (line 7337), NO visibility override passed. panelPickableWorksList (line 1969) is derived from panelWorks/panelRepertoire, reset-sync/refill-async exactly like libraryWorks (finding 3), but there is NO panelRepertoireLoading-equivalent flag anywhere in the file (zero grep hits) — so even after #311 lands, this caller has no signal to build a sticky override from and will keep using the component's naive default. (c) src/routes/event/[id]/+page.svelte lines 3076-3092 — its own direct <RepertoireElement> call, its own pickableWorksList (line 1464, off its own libraryWorks state, reset at line 420 / refilled at 920 / catch-reset at 926) — also passes NO pickableEditionsVisible override today, meaning this page already inherits the pre-#288 flicker on its programme picker, unaddressed. (d) Component-spec callers (render(RepertoireElement, ...)) — RepertoireElement.spec.ts, RepertoireElement.composer-label.spec.ts, RepertoireElement.ux.spec.ts, page.repertoire-a11y.spec.ts — all pass a synchronous, already-resolved pickableWorksList array (non-empty in every case that also grants editor rights, except one — see next finding).
findings.implication: Only ONE caller (+page.svelte's main agenda flow via AgendaList/worksManage) is positioned to hold the sticky override the issue's 'shape' section describes. The other two production callers (season-manage panel, event/[id] detail page) will silently inherit the naive pickableWorksList.length>0 default post-fix — same failure class #288 fixed on the main surface, left open on these two. Not a regression #311 introduces (event/[id] already has the identical unfixed gap for pickableEditionsVisible today), but real residual scope worth a line in the issue or a follow-up.

findings.claim: Specs driving manageAddControls/the Add Work picker: which flip under the new gate, which pin the three-cause behaviour, and the #288 remount-stickiness pattern to mirror.
findings.evidence: FLIPS: RepertoireElement.spec.ts lines 364-368, "rows.length === 0 with manageRights 'editor' → renders the 'Add' control directly, no disclosure at all" — calls render(RepertoireElement, { rows: [], manageRights: 'editor' }) with NO pickableWorksList (defaults to []), and asserts work-manage-add-work is NOT null. Under a mirrored default (pickableWorksList.length > 0), this becomes false and the assertion fails — needs an explicit non-empty pickableWorksList or a pickableWorksVisible:true override, or the assertion flips to .toBeNull(). NO OTHER RepertoireElement.spec.ts test flips: lines 545/559 (Add-work behavior) pass non-empty pickableWorksList; lines 744/763 (per-surface-rights) are already gated to null by canManageRepertoire===false. RepertoireElement.composer-label.spec.ts and RepertoireElement.ux.spec.ts only ever call with non-empty pickableWorksList — no flips. page.repertoire-a11y.spec.ts lines 705-712 and 728-737 both pass a non-empty single-work pickableWorksList — no flips. THREE-CAUSE PINS live in page.repertoire-manage-wiring.spec.ts's describe('#288 item 1 — the programme control keys visibility off "no options once loading has COMPLETED", not "no options right now"') (starting ~line 1108): pins 'still loading → visible' (~1128-1145), 'loading completed to genuine emptiness → hidden but wrapper/rows stay' (~1147-1177), and the REMOUNT-stickiness case (~1179-1220) which is the exact pattern to mirror: uses installReloadWorld() (defined ~line 964+) with armPickerHold()/releasePickerReads({editionsEmpty})/armRowHold()/releaseRowReads()/submitSeasonCreateAndEnterReload()/reExpandWorks() helpers. armPickerHold() holds BOTH the _type.string=work read AND the _type.string=edition read simultaneously (same listWorks+listAllEditions Promise.all that also feeds libraryWorks) — so a new pickableWorksVisible stickiness spec can reuse this exact harness without new fixture infrastructure, asserting on work-manage-add-work-select instead of work-manage-add-programme-select, and would need a new releasePickerReads({ worksEmpty: true }) option analogous to the existing editionsEmpty (which currently only nulls editions, not works) to drive the confirmed-empty case.
findings.implication: One concrete spec flip to fix (RepertoireElement.spec.ts:364-368) plus one reusable test harness to extend (page.repertoire-manage-wiring.spec.ts's installReloadWorld/releasePickerReads, adding a worksEmpty release option) for the new stickiness spec.

findings.claim: The library-genuinely-empty signal: what data would distinguish all-works-added from no-works-at-all, without designing it.
findings.evidence: pickableWorksList (pickableWorks(libraryWorks, seasonRepertoire), +page.svelte line 1955) is already the difference of two known page-level values: libraryWorks (every work in the collective's library) and seasonRepertoire (works already in this season's repertoire). libraryWorks.length === 0 once libraryPickersLoading has completed is the 'collective has no works at all' signal; libraryWorks.length > 0 && pickableWorksList.length === 0 (same load-completed gate) is 'every library work is already in the repertoire' — the correct-and-silent sub-case. Both numbers already sit in page state; nothing new needs to be fetched to tell them apart.
findings.implication: Confirms the issue's own framing that this is available, not speculative — the two counts exist today, un-wired to any UI decision. Left as description only, per the issue's explicit 'kept out of the done-when on purpose.'
